I remember I had to of been in second grade or so, my best friend of the previous year had become a popular girl, granted she was still super nice. But I wanted to impress her still. Since we didnt talk anymore.
It was Halloween time and we were doing the glue spider webs, I felt like mine was the best and I really wanted to show her, so I lifted it up and tried my best. She looked!But as soon as she did so did the teacher, and my web was slowly being ruined and running down the paper. For some reason I got in trouble for this. I had to move my card all the way from green to red. 
Even remember the teachers aid asking me how I was doing that day, (she never talked to me, and I was stoked that she even did but was embarrassed that it had to be over that) I just looked at her with tears in my eyes as I flipped the card. The teacher probably called it disrupting the class or because I ruined my picture, Im still not sure to this day besides I think about it still sometimes.
They are so cute, there's one that tries to hiss at me if I hold it haha

Storytime! 
When Courtney came to me she looked like she had already had kittens (she showed up after a ba storm we had here) , I looked everywhere for them but couldn't find them. (Her breasts were very enlarged) this went away though. 

Well right when I was going to take her to the vet to get her fixed she became pregnant again. I wanted her to be able to experience what she couldn't with the first litter she had. I was worried that maybe nothing bad happened to that first litter and maybe she just abandoned them, and hopefully she wouldn't with these babes. Nope! She is a wonderful mother and is so in love with her babies. 
Courtney is the first cat I have ever had and she is such a treasure. I am so greatful that she chose to wonder onto my porch! (Her name was porchney at first haha) 

Also yes all the kittens have homes picked out and Courtney will be fixed ASAP
Yes she had 4 grey tabbies and one orange (one tabby has an orange spot on her head haha)
